lines.text: Jesus touched a leper, cleansed him, and told him to show himself to the priest.
In Capernaum a centurion pleaded for his paralyzed servant, saying he was not worthy to have Jesus under his roof.
Jesus marveled at the centurion's faith and said many from north and south would feast with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Jesus healed the centurion's servant, then touched a sick woman's hand, and her fever left her.
